name: Fran Drescher
summary: Drescher is a Democratic-aligned actress who led SAG-AFTRA through the 2023 strike, framing it as workers against greedy studio executives, and has campaigned on women's cancer awareness and removing carcinogens from consumer products. She has called herself anti-capitalist and favors regulation of industry and AI, and has opposed COVID vaccine mandates. Her recorded positions on most political questions are few.
